This version cranks up the difficulty while also providing better rewards and infinite scaling to ensure that players can find a challenge no matter their build or skill level.

## Empowered vs Normal Monolith

Empowered Monolith Guide
Normal Timelines have their own area level, start at zero Corruption, and can only increase their Corruption to a maximum of 50. Empowered versions are all level 100, start at 100 Corruption, and can scale Corruption infinitely (provided you can handle the challenge).

There are also rewards that can only drop in Empowered Timelines or at levels of Corruption that can only be achieved in them. We'll discuss this in more detail in a later section.

## How To Empower Your Timelines

Empowered Monolith Guide
In order to activate the Empowered version of every Timeline, you need to complete the Normal version of one of these Timelines: Spirits of Fire, The Last Ruin, and The Age of Winter, and defeat the Harbinger at the end. Once it's complete, head to the center island between the three Timelines and click on the chest in the center. Empowered versions of every Timeline are now unlocked.

After completing the three listed Timelines, go to the spot highlighted by the yellow circle.

Now, when you access a Timeline, you always have two options. You can play the Normal version or the Empowered version by selecting the appropriate option. Each version's Echo Web retains its own Corruption and Stability, so you can switch between them as you choose and maintain progress.

Once you've successfully unlocked empowered, this is the option you get for each Timeline.

## Empowered Monolith Rewards

Empowered Monolith Guide
While the normal versions of each Timeline offer many rewards to players, there are some that are reserved exclusively for Empowered Timelines.

### Blessings

Empowered versions of each Timeline offer the same Blessings as the normal versions, but they roll much higher (example: Flames of the Black Sun is the normal Blessing, while Grand Flames of the Black Sun is the Empowered version).

### Boss Specific Uniques

Every Timeline boss has at least one Unique that is exclusive to Empowered. If you need a particular Unique that falls into this category, you're going to be farming it in Empowered.

-

###

- Fall of the Outcasts - Strands of Souls
- The Stolen Lance - Wings of Argentus
- The Black Sun - The Confluence of Fate
- Blood, Frost, and Death - Eulogy of Blood
- Ending the Storm - Eye of Storms
- Fall of the Empire - Anchor of Oblivion
- Reign of Dragons - Horns of Uhkeiros
- The Last Ruin - Sacrificial Embrace, Ravenous Void (these are also a random world drop in empowered, but at a massively lower drop rate)
- The Age of Winter - Faith of the Frozen
- Spirits of Fire - Trinity of Flames

Additionally, Shade of Orobyss has some Uniques that can only drop at certain levels of Corruption that are exclusive to Empowered.

-

###

- Apathy's Maw (While this technically can drop in normal at 50 Corruption it has a lower drop rate and there's no other reason to reach that level of Corruption so this should be farmed in empowered only.)
- Shattered Chains (Requires 150 Corruption)
- Omnis (Requires 200 Corruption)

## Special Echo Types

Empowered Monolith Guide
Aside from the regular Echoes, your Echo Web might contain special Echo types that can modify your entire Web.

### Beacon Echo

Normally, when you complete an Echo, you can see two steps ahead: the Echoes adjacent to the completed one and the ones directly beyond those. Beacon Echoes let you see further.

They contain a Beacon of Light, which can be charged to reveal all potential Echoes in a large ring around it.

### Echo of a World

As you expand your Echo Web, you will encounter Echoes that trigger an encounter with Shade of Orobyss. Successfully defeating this Boss resets your Echo Web and adds Corruption.

### Vessel of Chaos Echo

If you’ve spent time completing Echoes and claiming rewards in a Timeline, there will inevitably be a large number of Echoes that you have chosen not to complete. This is when a Vessel of Chaos becomes an exciting prospect.

Vessel of Chaos Echoes are rare, but completing one rerolls the rewards of all the Echoes that you have not yet completed, providing a chance for less enticing options to be swapped for more relevant rewards.

### Vessel of Memory Echo

Normally, when you complete an Echo, you can’t return to it and have to move on to your next choices. Vessel of Memory Echoes change this.

The objective of these rare Echoes is to smash the Vessel of Memory; destroying it resets the state of all existing Echoes on your Echo Web (aside from other Vessel Echoes). This allows you to re-run the Echo Web (starting from the completed Vessel of Memory) and claim all its rewards again.

## Corruption

Empowered Monolith Guide
You can see how much Corruption you have in the upper left hand corner of the Timeline interface.

While we covered Corruption in our Monolith Beginner Guide, it's worth revisiting the topic as it relates to Empowered, since this is where the mechanic is most prominent. Corruption is the primary source of progressing both the difficulty and rewards in the Empowered Monolith, allowing players to increase the health and damage of enemies while also increasing XP and Item Rarity.

### Item Rarity

In order to get the best items possible, you want to increase Item Rarity, which affects drops in a number of ways:

- Increases the likelihood that an item drops with more affixes. This also makes Exalted items more common since more affixes means a greater chance of finding an affix that rolls T6/T7.
- Increases the likelihood that an item will roll Unique.
- Increases the likelihood that a boss will drop a rare Unique.

Item Rarity is increased both by Corruption and Echo modifiers.

### Blessings

While Corruption doesn't directly affect Blessing drops or rolls, getting to 200 Corruption opens up an additional Blessing option from boss kills. If you're having trouble getting a Blessing you want at a high enough roll, make sure you're at 200+ Corruption to improve your chances!

### Other Benefits of Corruption

- As mentioned in the previous section, certain levels of Corruption are required in order for Shade of Orobyss to drop some Uniques.
- Corruption increases the amount of Stability gained from completing Echoes, allowing you to reach boss fights more quickly.
- The Echo Rewards are improved with Corruption. Example: High Corruption Echoes are more likely to offer Unique and Exalted rewards.
- Some Faction content like Harbingers and certain Woven Echoes like Threshold of Eternity have Corruption requirements in order to access them.

## Corruption Farming

Empowered Monolith Guide
Most of your goals in the Monolith of Fate are enhanced by Corruption, so it's quite important to learn all the tools that improve its gains. Don't farm any Corruption before reaching Empowered Monoliths. To increase Corruption, you must enter an Echo of a World and kill the Shade of Orobyss.

### Gaze of Orobyss

It is important to know that defeating the Timeline Boss in an Empowered Timeline grants you a Gaze of Orobyss.

Defeating the Shade of Orobyss consumes up to 4 Gaze of Orobyss within that Timeline to grant bonus Corruption, allowing you to build up Corruption more quickly. However, if you die while fighting the Shade of Orobyss, you lose 1 Gaze of Orobyss.

Corruption Panel with a Gaze of Orobyss

### Catch-up Mechanics

If one of your Timelines has more Corruption than others, you can catch up to your highest value relatively quickly in the other Timelines by completing an Echo of a World, as it grants bonus Corruption based on the highest that character has achieved. The further away you are from the Starting Echo Web Node, the more this mechanic grants. Completing the Confluence of Oblivion Woven Echo has similar benefits.

### Corruption Farm Strategy

- Clear Echoes as fast as possible. You can also use Temporal Keystone to spawn the Timeline Boss faster.
- Avoid Arena Echoes and huge Map Layouts, as they take longer to clear.
- Path your Echoes to get as far away as possible from the Starting Node of your Echo Web.
- Defeat the Timeline Boss to gain a Gaze of Orobyss. Defeat it with a Harbinger's Needle equipped to get additional Gaze of Orobyss.
- Defeat a Shade of Orobyss. If it's at the edge of your Web, it grants more Corruption.
- Repeat until you reach your desired Corruption.

## Summary

Empowered Monolith Guide
- Empowered Timelines are similar to Normal, except they start at level 100, have 100 Corruption, and Corruption can be scaled infinitely.
- To Empower your Timelines, you need to complete Spirits of Fire, The Last Ruin or The Age of Winter, and defeat the Harbinger at the end.
- Empowered Timelines offer many rewards above Normal, including better Blessings and exclusive Uniques.
- Corruption presents a greater challenge, but provides greater rewards. Item Rarity, more Blessing rolls, better Echo rewards, and even some exclusive Uniques can be gained from scaling Corruption.
